messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — drafting roadmap slices for the Optimize Toolkit (batching, caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts). Goal: define alpha/beta/GA scope, acceptance criteria, and operational gating. Need owners + customer asks prioritized. Thoughts?

Aj (Eng): for batching, alpha should be a recommendation engine + lightweight runtime hints (per-route continuous batching + suggested batch size). Alpha goal: measurable ~20-30% token cost reduction on targeted workloads. Need infra estimate.

Li (ML Eng): quantization plan: alpha = guidance + vetted profiles (int8 + dynamic-4bit) as recommendations; beta = automated conversion CLI + simple validation run. Quality guardrails: target <2% R@1 drop on eval suites for alpha recommendations.

Sam (CS): customer ask: explainability for recs — customers want to see "why" we suggested batching/quant (samples, expected cost savings, quality delta). Also insist on safe rollback path. Some customers won't accept >1% quality loss.

Nina (Design): noted. I'll sketch a compact UI card showing: signal triggers, expected savings, preview delta, and a 1-click apply/rollback. Need list of signals we expose (latency, token mix, p50/p95).

Aj (Eng): infra estimate for alpha: ~2w eng (core runtime hooks + metrics), plus 1w for a canary routing policy. SLO ask: p95 latency increase <= 10ms on sampled traffic when batching is applied. Also propose a feature-flagged rollout.

Amelia (SRE): ops constraints: we need eval-triggered alerting (post-deploy) — alert if any monitored eval metric deviates >3 sigma vs baseline for 24h. Retention: keep eval traces for 30d. Also require an auto-fallback to previous model/config if latency or error-rate thresholds breach.

Tom (Sales): prioritization note: push fintech and healthcare pilot slots to front of queue — they asked for private deployment compatibility and stronger audit logs. These customers will sign if we prove cost savings w/o regulatory risk.

Maya (PM): proposed slices:
- Alpha (pilot): recommendation engine + docs + onboarding for 2 pilot customers; basic UI card; acceptance criteria = docs + 2 pilot onboarded + SLOs met for 7d.
- Beta: automated quant CLI, eval-alerts wired to Ops, expanded UI controls, + 5 customers in pilot.
- GA: self-serve recommendations, A/B rollout policies, canned rollback, pricing guidance.
Does this alignment make sense? Any objections or missing gating criteria?

Aj (Eng): LGTM. One add: rollout safety net — auto-fallback to CPU or smaller model variant if token latency spikes or error-rate rises. Also add perf budget tests to CI.

Li (ML Eng): +1. Will need 1w to wire model-level eval harness into our pipeline so recommendations can include an immediate sanity check.

Sam (CS): I'll draft the customer test matrix (expected inputs, acceptance thresholds, rollback criteria) and sync with the two pilot customers. ETA: Thu EOD.

ops-bot: weekly reminder — release freeze starts Fri 22:00 UTC (reaction :calendar:).

Maya (PM): great. I'll convert this into a GH issue and ownership list. Owners: @Aj (infra lead), @Li (quant/ML), @Sam (customer onboarding), @Nina (UX), @Amelia (ops). I'll add the alpha acceptance checklist to the issue later today. :thumbsup:

Tom (Sales): flagging that finance wants a rough econ model (expected $/token delta) for the pilot so we can build a pricing pilot.

Maya (PM): noted — I'll add a simple econ template to the GH ticket. Thanks everyone.
